prompt: Which statements about pull requests are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Pull requests package a diff, a conversation, and a review workflow — including drafts for early feedback. Merging stays gated by permissions, and the base branch is a choice: any branch can receive a proposal.

options.text: A pull request shows the diff between two branches
Reviewers leave comments and approve or request changes
A pull request can be opened as a draft to signal work in progress
Anyone on the internet can merge a pull request in any public repository
Pull requests can only target the default branch as their base
